exam_scheme.note: The Indian Institute of Science (IISc) Bangalore admits undergraduate students to its 4-year Bachelor of Science (Research) and B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing programmes through national standardized examination channels rather than conducting its own separate written exam. The recognized entry channels are: (1) JEE Advanced, (2) JEE Main, (3) NEET-UG, and (4) the IISER Aptitude Test (IAT). For B.Tech (Mathematics and Computing), admission is exclusively through JEE Advanced. Candidates must qualify the respective national test and apply through the IISc admissions portal; merit lists are generated channel-wise based on respective ranks/percentiles.
